note: L6's real questions (docs/dev/PLAN-4.5-WIKI.md §4.6): each in English and French as a reader types it, the destinations a right answer lands on (one of them in search_docs' top 3 is a hit), the facts it must hold (level 2 grades by them), and the counter-examples of §4.6's table with their exact behaviour. `npm run wiki -- acceptance` runs level 1; a question whose pages are not written yet is pending. `beginner`: the ten questions of the docs-beginner-reader pass (level 3).

text.en: I want the guard to patrol between two rooms
text.fr: Je veux que le garde patrouille entre deux salles

facts: A looping script alternates wait, moveActor and emit (the nurse on patrol)
An events listener on the emitted event, plus the room onEnter check, catches the hero
Scripts run between player actions: the patrol is turn by turn, not real time; the solver proves it and saves restore it
A loop must hold wait, waitUntil or waitEvent; moveActor needs the actor declared in the target room

text.en: What's the difference between a flag and an event?
text.fr: Quelle différence entre un flag et un événement ?

facts: A flag is a state (the door is open); an event is a moment (the bell just rang)
emit runs the current room listeners, then the game ones; an event is not remembered
To react later, set a flag in the listener
Flags carry values: set, unset, inc; conditions flag with eq, gte, lt

text.en: I get a 423 error in the Studio
text.fr: J'ai une erreur 423 dans le Studio

facts: Context: a hosted team Studio; a write takes its span for 2 minutes, renewed while active
Cause: another member holds that span's lease (or an owner's exclusive lease); the error names them
Your draft is kept
Recovery: wait for the lease to end, ask the member, or an owner takes the span over (audited lease-takeover)
Not the 409, which is a stale base revision

text.en: My game works locally but not under a sub-path once deployed
text.fr: Mon jeu marche en local mais pas sous un sous-chemin une fois déployé

facts: GitHub Pages serves /<repo>/: build with BASE_PATH=/<repo>/
Assets, fonts, manifest, service worker and the sealed ending all honour the base
A custom domain at the root needs no BASE_PATH
Check locally with BASE_PATH=/my-repo/ npm run build, and the live site with scripts/e2e.mjs
gaps: A stale service worker's cache under a sub-path is not covered

text.en: Can I update the engine without losing the players' saves?
text.fr: Puis-je mettre à jour le moteur sans perdre les sauvegardes des joueurs ?

facts: A save from any 3.x or 4.x release loads in every later 4.x (envelope schema 4, schema 3 still read)
A save newer than the game is refused, never half read
An incompatible content change bumps saveVersion and adds one migrations step per version
Upgrade: npm install quest-n-click@<v>, npx quest-n-click migrate, npm run verify

text.en: Where do I run npm run studio: in the engine repository or in my project?
text.fr: Où se lance npm run studio : dans le dépôt du moteur ou dans mon projet ?

facts: Both work: in a created project the script calls quest-n-click studio with the project as working folder
In the engine repository the game is GAME, else config.game in package.json, else demo
Prerequisites: Node 22.12 or later; npx quest-n-click doctor says what is missing
It listens on 127.0.0.1 and serves the Studio at /__studio/

text.en: The solver finds an ending: does that mean my game has no softlock?
text.fr: Le solveur trouve une fin : ai-je exclu tous les blocages ?

facts: No: npm run solve finds one winning path (a witness)
Only npm run solve -- --prove explores every reachable state and reports softlocks
A search that hits its budget says truncated, proves nothing and exits 2
Proofs fold states through audited abstractions; with hero choice, --prove checks every hero

text.en: I have an old link to docs/en/CONTENT_GUIDE.md: where is that page now?
text.fr: J'ai un ancien lien vers docs/fr/CONTENT_GUIDE.md : où est cette page maintenant ?

facts: The old page stays as a transition page that keeps every old anchor
Each old heading links to its new destinations in the wiki
A fallback link to blob/v4.4.0/docs always works

text.en: How do I install the game on my iPhone to play offline?
text.fr: Comment installer le jeu sur mon iPhone pour jouer hors ligne ?

facts: Safari, then Share, Add to Home Screen; open it once online
The whole game is cached by default; the pause menu shows whole game cached or n/m
Nothing is cached with Save-Data or on 2G; a partial warm-up can be retried with a tap
Not verified by CI on a real iPhone: that is a people pass

text.en: My save won't load
text.fr: Ma sauvegarde ne se charge pas

facts: A save newer than the game is refused, never half read
A corrupt save, another game's, or one naming a missing room is rejected without changing the session
With save slots, Export and Import (a JSON file) are in the pause menu
With a world link, a save from another linked player is a mismatch: nothing applied, relink offered

text.en: I don't hear any sound in the game
text.fr: Je n'entends aucun son dans le jeu

facts: Sound unlocks at the first tap, click or key press (browser rule)
With settings on, the pause menu has separate music, sound and voice volumes, kept in the browser
gaps: The iPhone's mute switch and the browsers' autoplay rules are not explained to players

text.en: The game was updated but I still see the old version
text.fr: Le jeu a été mis à jour mais je vois toujours l'ancienne version

facts: The service worker keeps the app; an update is offered by a banner, Save and update
The update is offered only after a verified save
Changed asset files carry a new ?v=<hash> and bypass the old cache

text.en: What does a double tap do on my phone?
text.fr: Que fait un double tap sur mon téléphone ?

facts: One tap walks to a thing; a double tap acts without choosing a verb
It goes through an exit, talks to a character, otherwise looks
The sentence line says what the tap will do before you tap

text.en: What does the game keep about me?
text.fr: Que garde le jeu sur moi ?

facts: The save and sessions stay in IndexedDB on the device; without reality nothing leaves it
With a world link: a pseudonymous playerId and a capability in localStorage, never an email or token
Unlink revokes on the Bridge; erasing the save or site data removes the rest

text.en: An object is visible but my character cannot reach it
text.fr: Un objet est visible mais mon personnage ne peut pas y aller

facts: The geometry is in layout/<room>.json, placed with ?edit=<room> or the Studio, never typed
?dev (D) shows the walkable zone green, holes red, approach points filled or hollow
Drag the approach point inside the zone; a computed one never goes below floor (395 by default)
In multi-floor rooms a closed walkLink stops the walk (lint walk-link-gate)

text.en: How do I give only one hero a French voice?
text.fr: Comment donner une voix française à un seul héros ?

facts: Per-hero clips are keyed <id>~form=<value> in audio.voices; voicesByLang uses the same keys
Write {form?m=…|f=…} to record per hero; {hero} alone is not a switch
voicesByLang.fr replaces the base voices for French: no per-clip fallback to the English clip
The Voices tab heroes × languages matrix shows what is missing

text.en: Some texts are still in English in the French version
text.fr: Certains textes restent en anglais dans la version française

facts: A text missing from the translation file stays as written in the source language
npm run i18n -- extract --lang fr adds the missing texts; i18n -- status gives coverage and stale paths
Coverage also shows in validate -- --report and the Check tab; removed paths are parked under _stale

text.en: How do I write my own minigame?
text.fr: Comment écrire mon propre mini-jeu ?

facts: Register it in minigames in index.ts as {run(ctx): Promise<void>; required?}
ctx gives the overlay, scale, images, sounds, params and an abort signal
Call it with {minigame: id, params, then: […]}; required params are checked by the validator

text.en: The game still shows an old image after I changed it
text.fr: Le jeu affiche encore une ancienne image après l'avoir changée

facts: npm run assets rewrites public/assets and assets.gen.json, only what changed
A changed file gets a new ?v=<hash> that bypasses the cache
Generated files are committed; run npm run assets before the build; a hosted Studio uses Prepare

text.en: How do I start my first game?
text.fr: Comment commencer mon premier jeu ?

facts: npx create-quest-n-click my-game "My Game", then npm install, npm run assets, npm run dev
In the engine repository: npm run new-game <id> "<title>"
About 15 minutes to a first room

text.en: How do I write a conversation with a character?
text.fr: Comment écrire une conversation avec un personnage ?

facts: A room talk block lists topics per character, each with id, topic and do
Bye is added automatically
choice, {talk: char} and seen conditions; the MCP dialogue_tree tool shows the tree

text.en: Can I rename a room id without breaking saves?
text.fr: Puis-je renommer l'id d'une salle sans casser les sauvegardes ?

facts: Renaming an id breaks saves unless you bump saveVersion and add a migration step (renameRoom, renameFlag…)
The validator refuses missing or duplicate v3 ids

text.en: How do I try my game on my phone over Wi-Fi?
text.fr: Comment essayer mon jeu sur mon téléphone en Wi-Fi ?

facts: npm run dev:lan (or studio:lan) prints a URL with a fresh capability token
Open it on the phone, in landscape

text.en: How do I connect Claude Code to my game?
text.fr: Comment brancher Claude Code sur mon jeu ?

facts: The repository ships .mcp.json: approve the quest-n-click server
Or claude mcp add quest-n-click -- npm run -s mcp; -s keeps stdout for the protocol
GAME=<id> picks the game

text.en: How do I check my game before sharing it?
text.fr: Comment vérifier mon jeu avant de le partager ?

facts: npm run validate, npm run solve, solve -- --prove, npm test, npm run lint
validate and solve exit 1 on a blocking problem; solve exits 2 on truncated
In a created project: quest-n-click verify

text.en: How do I make music in stems that change with the room?
text.fr: Comment faire une musique en pistes qui change selon la salle ?

facts: npm run audio -- stems <project>/spec.json writes <slug>-stems/*.mp3 and a score.json for audio.scores
One common gain to −14 LUFS; every stem has the same rate, channels and length
The single mix stays as fallback

text.en: How do I let the player choose their hero?
text.fr: Comment laisser le joueur choisir son héros ?

facts: One flag (form), one character with variants, an intro choice with img cards, {form?…} switches
Run solve -- --prove for every hero
Example game: GAME=heroes

text.en: Where is my API key kept when I use the Studio Assistant?
text.fr: Où est gardée ma clé d'API quand j'utilise l'Assistant du Studio ?

facts: The key is stored in this browser's localStorage only, kept in memory by the relay, never logged
Forget the key removes it
Without a key, Send as a task to the AI agent writes a note for MCP; not on a hosted Studio

text.en: How do I create a game from the release archive?
text.fr: Comment créer un jeu depuis l'archive de la release ?

facts: npx --package=$T quest-n-click create my-game "My Game" --engine=$T, with T the release .tgz URL

text.en: doctor says something is missing on my machine
text.fr: doctor dit qu'il manque quelque chose sur ma machine

facts: npm run doctor or npx quest-n-click doctor: Node and Chromium required; Python, ffmpeg and WebKit optional
--release requires Python and ffmpeg

text.en: I was invited to a team's Studio: how do I start?
text.fr: J'ai été invité sur le Studio d'une équipe : comment commencer ?

facts: An invitation is valid 7 days, used once, for a verified email; log in through the OIDC provider
The dev role writes span by span; a reviewer reads and plays
The CLI logs in with studio-server -- login --server <url> (device flow)

text.en: The hosted Studio shows an old preview after my teammate changed the room
text.fr: Le Studio hébergé montre un ancien aperçu après la modification d'un collègue

facts: The preview label names the revision shown; the Play tab needs Load the latest preview
A game frame idle past its 15-minute session shows nothing new: use Reload view
Check results are marked stale once the head moves

text.en: The Studio answers 503 while I redeploy it on Clever Cloud
text.fr: Le Studio répond 503 pendant que je le redéploie sur Clever Cloud

facts: Instances share a service lease in PostgreSQL (30 s, renewed every 10 s); the new one answers 503 with Retry-After until it holds it
Measured: writes refused 10 to 16 s; about a minute of slow or refused writes, none lost if retried with the operation id
The dev PostgreSQL plan (5 connections) fails with too many connections during the overlap

text.en: Nobody is owner of our Studio anymore
text.fr: Plus personne n'est propriétaire de notre Studio

facts: The last owner can be neither removed nor demoted
Recovery: clever ssh, then npm run studio-server -- invite --email … --role owner
Keycloak decides identity only, never roles

text.en: How do I rotate STUDIO_SESSION_KEY?
text.fr: Comment faire tourner STUDIO_SESSION_KEY ?

facts: STUDIO_SESSION_KEY takes several comma-separated keys, each 32 characters or more
The first key seals, every listed key opens: add the new key first, keep the old one listed
Dropping an old key loses the sessions sealed with it

text.en: How do I restore the Studio on an empty database?
text.fr: Comment restaurer le Studio sur une base vide ?

facts: restore <file> --replay runs into an empty database only (a new add-on, same bucket); a non-empty one is refused
If it fails midway, the server will not start until studio-server -- replay is run; a restore logs everyone out
Measured: about a minute (59.7 s with replay, 4.2.3), an observation, not a promise

text.en: Safari users lose the game cookie on our hosted Studio
text.fr: Sur Safari, le cookie du jeu se perd sur notre Studio hébergé

facts: Use two subdomains of your own domain (studio., play.) so the game frame keeps its cookie
Two *.cleverapps.io names are two sites: the cookie survives only partitioned (CHIPS)
A real Safari is the unverified studio-hosted pass
gaps: A login loop on Safari is not described

text.en: How do I change our Studio's domain name?
text.fr: Comment changer le nom de domaine de notre Studio ?

facts: Change publicUrl and playUrl in STUDIO_CONFIG_JSON; add the domains with clever domain add
Update the provider: <publicUrl>/auth/callback, /auth/backchannel, post-logout <publicUrl>
Users are keyed by issuer and subject: a new OIDC provider means new identities
gaps: No step-by-step procedure for changing the OIDC provider

text.en: How do I back up the hosted Studio every day?
text.fr: Comment sauvegarder le Studio hébergé chaque jour ?

facts: studio-server -- backup <file>, or backup --to-bucket --keep 14
A daily cron at 03:17 UTC with STUDIO_BACKUP_CRON=1
The journal is shipped to the bucket; the RPO target is 1 minute

text.en: How do I invite someone to the Studio?
text.fr: Comment inviter quelqu'un sur le Studio ?

facts: studio-server -- invite --email … --role owner|dev|reviewer
An invitation is valid 7 days and used once

text.en: How do I remove a member from the Studio?
text.fr: Comment retirer un membre du Studio ?

facts: Removal ends access at the next request; live streams close within 5 s
An account disabled at the provider ends within 15 minutes
The last owner cannot be removed

text.en: How do I upgrade the Studio Server to a new version?
text.fr: Comment mettre à jour le Studio Server vers une nouvelle version ?

facts: Read the CHANGELOG and UPGRADING, back up to the bucket first
Deploy the worker first, then the studio, same version
Check /readyz answers 200

text.en: Which Keycloak clients does the Studio need?
text.fr: Quels clients Keycloak faut-il pour le Studio ?

facts: studio: confidential, PKCE S256; web-scumm-cli: device grant with offline_access
Audience studio-api; access tokens 5 minutes (at most 900 s)

text.en: Which checks do I run before opening a pull request?
text.fr: Quelles vérifications lancer avant une pull request ?

facts: npm run quality, npm run check, npm run test:assets, npm run verify:game
For a visual change, add e2e:smoke

text.en: A mutant survived in the mutation tests: what do I do?
text.fr: Un mutant a survécu aux tests de mutation : que faire ?

facts: A gated set fails on any survivor not named in docs/dev/mutants.json
Kill it with a test, or record it with category, why, proof, owner and revisit
npm run test:mutation:core -- --set=<set>; --doc regenerates the table

text.en: The coverage ratchet is red on my branch
text.fr: Le cliquet de couverture est rouge sur ma branche

facts: npm run test:coverage, then tools/coverage-ratchet.ts --strict
It fails on a floor 3 or more points behind
It warns on a pull request and is strict on main and tags

text.en: My changes/ fragment is refused
text.fr: Mon fragment changes/ est refusé

facts: changes/<branch without prefix>.md holds only ### Breaking, ### Fixed or ### Changes; text before the first heading is refused
npm run changes -- --check fails a branch touching src/, bridge/, tools/, scripts/, cli/, connectors/ or games/ without a fragment
The optional .log.md starts with ## <title> and ends with a → next: line

text.en: How do I set up my machine to work on the engine?
text.fr: Comment préparer ma machine pour travailler sur le moteur ?

facts: Node 22.12 or later, Python 3 with requirements.txt, ffmpeg for audio
npm ci, npx playwright install chromium, then npm run doctor

text.en: quality:baseline --check fails after I added a test
text.fr: quality:baseline --check échoue après l'ajout d'un test

facts: A new test means rerunning npm run quality:baseline without --check and committing the result
npm run quality:baseline -- --check must then stay green

text.en: A CI job failed for no reason on my pull request
text.fr: Un job de CI a échoué sans raison sur ma pull request

facts: npm run ship -- checks allows one re-run of a failed job
gaps: No flaky-test policy is written for contributors in docs/en

text.en: The Bridge received the same event twice
text.fr: Le Bridge a reçu deux fois le même événement

facts: POST /v1/signals answers 202 accepted, and 200 for a dedupeKey already accepted
Delivery is at least once, applied once; a resend gets duplicate
The save keeps sequences, so a signal is never applied twice

text.en: A connector is down: what happens to the game?
text.fr: Un connecteur est en panne : que devient le jeu ?

facts: Offline or without a signal the game plays on; what arrived meanwhile is applied later
A connector's GET /health answers 200 or 503
An unsent email stays unseen and is retried at the next poll; a 429 is never a silent drop

text.en: How do I set up the email connector?
text.fr: Comment configurer le connecteur e-mail ?

facts: Two modes: a signed webhook (POST /v1/inbound, HMAC, 5-minute window) or imap over TLS
Messages capped at 256 KB, attachments refused; keepDays 0 deletes a message once accepted
No reply is sent

text.en: Can I make a real-time multiplayer game?
text.fr: Puis-je faire un jeu multijoueur en temps réel ?

facts: Real-time multiplayer is not supported: a game has one player at a time
The Reality Bridge links a game to real-world signals; it is not multiplayer

text.en: How do I export my game to Steam?
text.fr: Comment exporter mon jeu sur Steam ?

facts: There is no Steam export: a game is a static web site (and a PWA)
What exists: build and release for static hosts

text.en: What does npm run studio open?
text.fr: Que lance npm run studio ?

facts: In the engine repository: the game from GAME, config.game or .cache/game (default demo)
In a created project: quest-n-click studio with the project as working folder, game/ instead of games/<id>/
Both on loopback; neither is the hosted Studio Server

text.en: How do I make a backup?
text.fr: Comment faire une sauvegarde de secours ?

facts: Bridge: npm run bridge -- backup --out=<file>, restore --from= --mode=merge|replace-store
Studio Server: npm run studio-server -- backup <file> [--to-bucket --keep 14], restore <file> --replay

text.en: How do I migrate my v2 ids to v3?
text.fr: Comment migrer mes ids v2 en v3 ?

facts: npm run ids, then npm run ids -- --write --map; schemaVersion 3, saveVersion + 1, migrations [idsMigration]
It applies to a game still at authoring schema 2 (4.1.x), not to 4.5.0
On a hosted Studio, POST /api/engine/migrate upgrades a schema-2 game

text.en: Error 409
text.fr: Erreur 409

facts: On the hosted Studio: a stale base revision (x-studio-base); the draft is kept
On the Bridge: a conflict such as a pairing code confirmed twice or a duplicate run submission

text.en: Error 503
text.fr: Erreur 503

facts: On Clever Cloud: a redeploy, until the new instance holds the service lease (Retry-After)
On the Bridge: the store does not answer (/readyz), a SQLite lock wait over 5 s, or a lost maintenance lease

text.en: no sound
text.fr: pas de son

facts: Browsers play a page's sound only after a first tap, click or key: the title screen is silent until then
The game's sound button, the pause menu's Music and Sound rows, and the volumes in the settings can mute it
A muted device, or an iPhone's silent switch, silences web pages

text.en: no sound
text.fr: pas de son

facts: Browsers play a page's sound only after a first tap, click or key: the title screen is silent until then
The game's sound button, the pause menu's Music and Sound rows, and the volumes in the settings can mute it
A muted device, or an iPhone's silent switch, silences web pages

text.en: the game has no sound
text.fr: aucun son

facts: Browsers play a page's sound only after a first tap, click or key: the title screen is silent until then
The game's sound button, the pause menu's Music and Sound rows, and the volumes in the settings can mute it
A muted device, or an iPhone's silent switch, silences web pages

text.en: I hear nothing
text.fr: je n'entends rien

facts: Browsers play a page's sound only after a first tap, click or key: the title screen is silent until then
The game's sound button, the pause menu's Music and Sound rows, and the volumes in the settings can mute it
A muted device, or an iPhone's silent switch, silences web pages

text.en: Studio token required
text.fr: Le Studio dit « Studio token required »

facts: On the LAN (npm run studio:lan), the Studio refuses a request without the session's token
Open the authorised URL the command printed, which carries the token

text.en: check my game before sharing it
text.fr: vérifier son jeu avant de le partager

facts: validate, solve, lint and the playtests check a game; npm run verify runs them in a created project
solve --prove looks for dead ends within its budgets

text.en: a player loses their inventory after an update
text.fr: le joueur perd son inventaire après une mise à jour

facts: An item the new version no longer has is dropped from the save, which loads with a warning
Renaming an item with a migration (renameItem) carries it over
